# Character Dossier & Modular Sheets

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
from sr6core.character_manager import CharacterManager
from sr6core.exporters.vtt_text import (
    export_base_sheet,
    export_contacts_sheet,
    export_combat_sheet,
    export_inventory_sheet,
    export_vehicles_sheet,
    export_powers_sheet,
)

cm = CharacterManager()
char_data = cm.get_character_data("yuriko")

base_txt = export_base_sheet(char_data, char_repo_path=".")
combat_txt = export_combat_sheet(char_data)
contacts_txt = export_contacts_sheet(char_data)
inventory_txt = export_inventory_sheet(char_data)
vehicles_txt = export_vehicles_sheet(char_data)
powers_txt = export_powers_sheet(char_data)
```

::: {.callout-note}
### Downloadable Character Sheets & Card Decks
* **Printable Index Card Deck (4.25" x 5.5" / 4" x 6" Laserjet PDF)**: [yuriko_cards_deck.pdf](../output/pdf/yuriko_cards_deck.pdf)
* **Printable Base Sheet (1-Page PDF)**: [yuriko_base_sheet.pdf](../output/pdf/yuriko_base_sheet.pdf)
* **VTT & CommLink6 Saves**: [yuriko.xml](../output/vtt/yuriko.xml) | [yuriko.json](../output/vtt/yuriko.json)
:::
